$comment: Achievements: one configuration for every badge. level: knowledge (auto-checked understanding: reading checks, tests), applied (interactive labs and challenges), communication (real speaking performances; teacher-verified only). status: active = can be earned now from activities that exist; pending-verification = needs a teacher verification process that does not exist yet, so it is never awarded automatically; coming = belongs to an experience that is not built yet (integrates later; never awarded now). Criteria types: ai (an AI Coaching Studio mastery part: ethics, ownership or factcheck, read from speakup-ai-v1), btp (a Beyond the Podium mastery part: detective, change or apply, read from speakup-btp-v1), quiz (unit reading check best %), test (unit practice test best %), lab (activities a lab reports as mastered), labDone (Persuasion & Rhetoric Lab activities finished), listenFinal (Art of Listening final check best %), audCheck (Respectful Audience check best, out of 10), improved (different checks whose best score rose after a retry, counted from the first time the site saw them), external (a separate experience; planned). Badges are informal learning achievements: progress is saved in this browser only and is not an official grade or a credential.
